video_title: Your Questions Answered: Relationships, Rumors, Real Life & Lego!

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the hostile environment of playing in Toronto
quotes.excerpt: Playing against Toronto for us is like they're the only basketball team in Canada.
quotes.quote: Playing against Toronto for us is like they're the only basketball team in Canada. They show out pretty much every game. I played them in the playoffs, it's loud, so I'll definitely say Scotiabank Arena is a big one.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the disruptive atmosphere at Oklahoma City games
quotes.excerpt: They be on some bullshit because they'll blare music like right before the game.
quotes.quote: If I got to say OKC, they're loud, they be on some bullshit because they'll blare music like right before the game. There's only one hotel downtown and they always have these festivals and shit the night before or the day of the game so they blare music like right before the game and that shit pissed me off last year.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the intense atmosphere of playing in France
quotes.excerpt: When we played France in the gold medal game in France in the last Olympics, that was nuts.
quotes.quote: When we played France in the gold medal game in France in the last Olympics, that was nuts.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the atmosphere during the 2018 WNBA semifinals
quotes.excerpt: When we were in the semifinal series in 2018, it was nuts in that arena.
quotes.quote: When we were in the semifinal series in 2018, it was nuts in that arena.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the New York Liberty's championship expectations
quotes.excerpt: It's not like or bust, well it is, but it's just like we're just trying to win.
quotes.quote: It's not like or bust, well it is, but it's just like we're just trying to win. It's just expectations regardless. We know we have the talent, we have the people, we can do it, we just need to all continue to build that chemistry camaraderie.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the possibility of Martha Stewart coaching
quotes.excerpt: If someone wants to offer Martha a max contract then they can talk to me.
quotes.quote: If someone wants to offer Martha a max contract then they can talk to me. But no, I think that sometimes she misses it, but not that much. She just not want to come back to play and if she was my teammate she probably would like foul out because anybody that hit me she would definitely hit them. In coaching, no, I don't think so. She's never like oh let's watch basketball.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the impact of a supportive partner on his career
quotes.excerpt: My life, my career changed when she into my life.
quotes.quote: I've been with my girlfriend for four years now and I tell all the time like my life, my career changed when she into my life. It changed my mindset, it changed my mentality. I had the most success I've had in my career with her by my side.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on dealing with constant NBA trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: I had my bags packed twice. I thought at one point in my career I was going to be traded.
quotes.quote: I'm so numb to it now. At the very beginning of my career, I was in a trade rumor every single offseason. I had my bags packed twice. I thought at one point in my career I was going to be traded to Boston for Gordon Hayward and I thought I literally was ready to go and then that fell through at the last second. And then I also thought I was going to be traded to the Lakers for a while. So I'm so numb to it now, if it happens it happens and it's just part of the business.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the New York Liberty's history at MSG
quotes.excerpt: The Liberty used to play at MSG and then James Dolan didn't want the Liberty anymore.
quotes.quote: The Liberty used to play at MSG and then James Dolan didn't want the Liberty anymore, so the Tsai's bought it and brought us with the Nets. I don't think there's like bad blood there, but maybe like a random game, especially now that we have the retro uniforms, it would be cool to like wear the retro uniform, have the court back in MSG, but it would need to be like a special game, not a all the time game.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the importance of player development coaches
quotes.excerpt: There's such a difference between teaching and execution.
quotes.quote: There's a couple factors. One, I think it helps when the player development coach has played the game at this level or at least a high level. I think it helps when that person knows exactly what's going through your head. There's such a difference between teaching and execution. I think the levels of mastery comes with being able to not only teach the game but like make somebody understand.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on building trust with player development coaches
quotes.excerpt: You can tell when that trust is being built.
quotes.quote: You can tell when that trust is being built and then you can like as a player you're more receptive to when your PD coach is saying something to you when it's like you've built the relationship and it's not coming in from day one like do this, do this, you suck at this.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on Myles Turner as a workout partner
quotes.excerpt: I think Martha is like my best workout partner because sometimes she doesn't want to work out with me.
quotes.quote: I think Martha is like my best workout partner because sometimes she doesn't want to work out with me, but like you know I feel like as athletes we're always used to like working out by ourselves, especially when you're like putting yourself through an offseason grind and you just need like a little bit of extra support, she takes one for the team and does it with me.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the competitive nature of workout partners
quotes.excerpt: It's one thing to push yourself, it's another thing to have someone else who can mind their own business.
quotes.quote: It's one thing to push yourself, it's another thing to have someone else who can mind their own business, but you're almost like using them to push you even further.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the importance of defensive IQ
quotes.excerpt: I would say defensive intensity, I would say defensive IQ.
quotes.quote: I would say defensive intensity, I would say defensive IQ. Everyone should bring defensive intensity, but to understand why you're doing it and why you're like going to help side or weak side or like going for a steal is pretty important.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the longevity benefits of offensive skill
quotes.excerpt: It'll keep you in the league longer too in my opinion, offensive skill.
quotes.quote: It'll keep you in the league longer too in my opinion, offensive skill.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on his pre-game music routine
quotes.excerpt: I love metal. I really start getting into Metallica like before games.
quotes.quote: I love metal. I really start getting into Metallica like before games. That's got me right. Megadeth's another one that's got me right as well. Linkin Park, they're not metal but they got some rager shit in there too.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on her favorite career moment
quotes.excerpt: The first ever championship in franchise history, like yeah, that's a best career moment.
quotes.quote: The first ever championship in franchise history, like yeah, that's a best career moment.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on his career highlight of reaching the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: Advancing to the finals, you know, we got to do it on our home floor.
quotes.quote: Advancing to the finals, you know, we got to do it on our home floor. For me personally, I just never thought it was possible. I never won a high school championship, I only played a year in college and I got on the first round and before that, my other 10 years prior I had only been in the first round. So to go from zero championship experience to like actually getting to the big game, like it was such a revelation just for me personally.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on his parents' support throughout his career
quotes.excerpt: My parents, they're my everything, man. They have supported me through and through.
quotes.quote: My parents, they're my everything, man. They have supported me through and through no matter what decisions I've made in life and they have helped me immensely. They've exemplified what it means like to be parents and to get me to this level. My mom emptied her retirement fund to fund like my AAU. My dad worked the night shift, so I barely saw him during the day, but if I had a game he would sneak out of work, get someone to cover his shift and watch.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the sacrifices her parents made for her career
quotes.excerpt: My parents also made huge sacrifices for me to be able to play basketball.
quotes.quote: My parents also made huge sacrifices for me to be able to play basketball and travel all over the place and waking up early in the morning to get in the car to go to the AAU practice and go down to the YMCA.
